# CPP Module 01

## Overview
Dynamic memory, references, pointers, switch-like behavior with classes, and basic file manipulation.

## Exercises
- ex00: Zombie
- ex01: Zombie Horde
- ex02: HI THIS IS BRAIN
- ex03: Human and Weapon
- ex04: Replace
- ex05: Harl 2.0
- ex06: Harl Filter

## Build and run
```bash
cd ex00 && make && ./zombie
cd ../ex01 && make && ./zombie
cd ../ex02 && make && ./brain
cd ../ex03 && make && ./human
cd ../ex0cd ../ex0cd ../ex0cd ../ex0cd ../ex0cd ../ex0cd ../ex0cd ../ex0cd l
 ./a.out
cd ../ex02 && make && ./a.out
```

## Notes
- Respect Orthodox Canonical Form where requested.
- Validate arithmetic and comparison semantics.
